summary:
This repository is a React + Vite account-signup demo (`src/pages/Signup.jsx`, `Login.jsx`, `Welcome.jsx`, shared styles in `src/style.css`). There is no Angular, no `AppModule`, no Bootstrap, no navbar, and no tutorials entity — so items 1–3 describe an application that does not exist here, and I did not invent one. I took the smaller reading: apply item 4's generic visual polish to the files this repo actually has.

Changed:
- `index.html` — linked the Inter Google font with preconnects (this project's entry HTML is at the repo root, not `src/index.html`).
- `src/style.css` (the shared stylesheet) — Inter as the primary font family, kept the existing light-grey page background, added an `--accent-dark` and a soft `--shadow` to the one existing colour scheme, softened card radius/padding with a shadow, rounded inputs with a focus glow instead of a hard outline, and added smooth hover/active transitions on buttons and links.

No component logic, routes, or dependencies were touched. No test files exist in this repo, so there were none to update. Project password rules were not touched by this visual-only change.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar, footer: This repo is React + Vite with a minimal path router; there is no Angular, AppModule, navbar or Tutorial Manager app to move — would require inventing a different application
Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid, search bar, status pills, empty state, red Remove All: No tutorials entity, list page or service exists in this repository
Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit tutorial pages with Bootstrap alerts: No Add/Edit tutorial pages and no Bootstrap in this repository
Not applied -- Update the existing component tests to match: This repository contains no component tests (only a Playwright devDependency, with no spec files)

Visual verification failed: The signup page at /signup does render the modern polish (Inter font, light grey background, rounded white card with soft shadow, rounded inputs, solid primary button), but the five password rules are not displayed under the Password field, violating the project rule that password rules from PasswordRules.jsx must always be shown wherever a password is chosen; no navbar/footer or card grid exists either (those items are Angular-specific and not applicable to this React repo).

visual_check.evidence: The signup page at /signup does render the modern polish (Inter font, light grey background, rounded white card with soft shadow, rounded inputs, solid primary button), but the five password rules are not displayed under the Password field, violating the project rule that password rules from PasswordRules.jsx must always be shown wherever a password is chosen; no navbar/footer or card grid exists either (those items are Angular-specific and not applicable to this React repo).

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: index.html only mounts /src/main.jsx and src/style.css is pure CSS. All account state is client-side via localStorage key 'acme-users' (map keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. Client-side routes are /signup, /login, /welcome.
